newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Italy sends emergency medical aid to Albania.
newsitem.headline: Italy sends emergency medical aid to Albania.

text.p: Five Italian helicopters landed in the rebel-held southern Albanian port of Vlore on Sunday bringing emergency medical aid.
A local doctor said the aid flight had been organised by local committees representing rebels who seized control of most of the south earlier this month and the Italian embassy.
"We are happy such an operation was successful because we badly needed medical equipment," local hospital director Servet Kojdheli told Reuters.
He said nearly two tonnes of medical equipment had been brought in, "enough to set up a new surgical ward".

Kojdheli said up to six Italian surgeons were due to be flown into Vlore on Monday to operate on over 50 people seriously wounded and dozens more slighly injured in the armed anarchy that broke out after rebels looted army depots and seized control of southern towns.
The Italian government is also due to fly medical aid to the capital Tirana in the north of the country, which is under government control, following a request from Prime Minister Bashkim Fino.
